description: Custom build of lodash library (version 3.10.1) including template and escape functions, with internal utility functions and template settings.

methods.name: lodash.template
methods.description: Compiles a template string into a function with support for interpolate, escape, and evaluate delimiters.

methods.name: lodash.escape
methods.description: Escapes characters in a string to their corresponding HTML entities.

methods.name: lodash.attempt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a function, returning the result or caught error.

methods.name: lodash.keys
methods.description: Returns an array of own enumerable property names of an object.

methods.name: lodash.keysIn
methods.description: Returns an array of own and inherited enumerable property names of an object.

methods.name: lodash.restParam
methods.description: Creates a function that invokes `func` with the `this` binding and arguments from `start` onward as an array.
